request_routes.label: Bevacizumab for non-ocular oncology indications
request_routes.routing_notes: Coverage limited to the non-ocular oncology indications and continuation criteria explicitly listed; other uses are considered experimental or investigational.
request_routes.evidence: I. Criteria for Initial Approval and II. Continuation of Therapy describe the medically necessary non-ocular oncology indications for bevacizumab and its biosimilars.

condition_clusters.condition_label: Intestinal-type ampullary adenocarcinoma (progressive or metastatic)
condition_clusters.evidence: A. ampullary adenocarcinoma - for treatment of intestinal-type ampullary adenocarcinoma that is progressive, or metastatic;

condition_clusters.condition_label: Appendiceal neoplasms and cancers
condition_clusters.evidence: B. Appendiceal neoplasms and cancers - for treatment of appendiceal neoplasms and appendiceal cancers (including appendiceal adenocarcinoma, goblet cell adenocarcinoma, undifferentiated carcinoma not otherwise specified, and low-grade and high-grade appendiceal mucinous neoplasm);

condition_clusters.condition_label: Central nervous system cancers listed in the policy
condition_clusters.evidence: C. Central nervous system (CNS) cancers - for treatment of the following types of CNS cancer: circumscribed glioma; diffuse high grade gliomas; glioblastoma; H3-mutated high-grade glioma; high-grade astrocytoma with piloid features (HGAP); intracranial and spinal ependymoma (excludes subependymoma); IDH mutant astrocytoma (WHO Grade 2, 3 or 4); oligodendroglioma (WHO Grade 2 or 3); medulloblastoma; pleomorphic xanthoastrocytoma (PXA) (WHO Grade 2 or 3); primary central nervous system lymphoma; meningiomas; limited and extensive brain metastases; metastatic spine tumors; primary spinal cord tumors;

condition_clusters.condition_label: Persistent, recurrent, or metastatic cervical cancer
condition_clusters.evidence: D. Cervical cancer - for treatment of persistent, recurrent, or metastatic cervical cancer;

condition_clusters.condition_label: Colorectal cancer (including appendiceal adenocarcinoma) and anal adenocarcinoma
condition_clusters.evidence: E. Colorectal cancer, including appendiceal adenocarcinoma, and anal adenocarcinoma;

section_path: E. Colorectal cancer, including appendiceal adenocarcinoma, and anal adenocarcinoma

condition_clusters.condition_label: Stage III-IV, persistent, recurrent, or metastatic endometrial carcinoma
condition_clusters.evidence: F. Endometrial carcinoma - for treatment of stage III-IV, persistent, recurrent, or metastatic endometrial carcinoma;

condition_clusters.condition_label: Unresectable or extrahepatic/metastatic hepatocellular carcinoma with atezolizumab
condition_clusters.evidence: G. Hepatocellular carcinoma - for treatment of unresectable or extrahepatic/metastatic hepatocellular carcinoma, when the requested medication will be used in combination with atezolizumab;

condition_clusters.condition_label: Pleural, peritoneal, pericardial, or tunica vaginalis testis mesothelioma systemic therapy
condition_clusters.evidence: H. Mesothelioma - for treatment of pleural mesothelioma, peritoneal mesothelioma, pericardial mesothelioma, or tunica vaginalis testis mesothelioma when a) as first-line therapy in combination with pemetrexed and either cisplatin or carboplatin, followed by single-agent maintenance bevacizumab; or b) as subsequent therapy in combination with pemetrexed and either cisplatin or carboplatin if immunotherapy was administered as first-line treatment;

condition_clusters.condition_label: Induction therapy for pleural, peritoneal, pericardial, or tunica vaginalis testis mesothelioma
condition_clusters.evidence: H. Mesothelioma - for induction treatment of pleural mesothelioma, peritoneal mesothelioma, or tunica vaginalis testis mesothelioma when used in combination with pemetrexed and either cisplatin or carboplatin prior to surgical exploration for clinical stage I disease with epithelioid histology;

condition_clusters.condition_label: Mesothelioma therapy in combination with atezolizumab
condition_clusters.evidence: H. Mesothelioma - for treatment of peritoneal mesothelioma, pericardial mesothelioma, or tunica vaginalis testis mesothelioma when used in combination with atezolizumab as subsequent therapy;

condition_clusters.condition_label: Recurrent, unresectable, advanced, or metastatic non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer
condition_clusters.evidence: I. Non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) - for treatment of recurrent, unresectable, advanced, or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC;

condition_clusters.condition_label: Continuation of bevacizumab for non-squamous NSCLC
condition_clusters.evidence: II. Continuation of Therapy - Non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) reauthorization is medically necessary when there is no evidence of unacceptable toxicity or disease progression while on the current regimen, or when continuation is planned with bevacizumab in combination with erlotinib provided the disease is T790M negative and there is no evidence of unacceptable toxicity;

condition_clusters.condition_label: Continuation of bevacizumab for CNS cancers
condition_clusters.evidence: II. Continuation of Therapy - CNS cancer reauthorization is medically necessary when there is no evidence of unacceptable toxicity or disease progression on the current bevacizumab regimen, or when disease progression occurred on single-agent bevacizumab, there is no evidence of unacceptable toxicity, and carmustine, lomustine, or temozolomide is being added for the listed CNS cancer subtypes;

condition_clusters.condition_label: Continuation of bevacizumab for other listed indications
condition_synonyms: Continuation for other covered non-ocular indications
condition_clusters.evidence: II. Continuation of Therapy - all other indications listed in Criteria for Initial Approval are medically necessary for reauthorization when there is no evidence of unacceptable toxicity or disease progression while on the current regimen;
